history_summary.value: The Crevecoeur is among the oldest French chicken breeds, from the Pays d'Auge in Normandy. It suffered heavy losses in both World Wars and was thought nearly extinct after the second, before Jean-Claude Perriquet began a recovery effort in 1976; it remains a Livestock Conservancy-listed endangered breed.
